description: CREATE ... IF NOT EXISTS across object kinds (database, schema, table, view, function, procedure, task, stream, warehouse, stage, user, role): the second create succeeds silently, the plain create refuses where the Java asserted it, idempotent setup scripts run twice, and IF NOT EXISTS composes with DROP IF EXISTS. Converted 1:1 from ddl/CreateIfNotExistsTest (now retired; it ran over JDBC but was pure SQL).
